updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
- Fix JF-17 not being detected
- Adds Dark Mode for Vaicom UI
- Adds F-14 Jester Grid Nav changes
- Adds C130J-30 as Single Hotkey module
- Adds CH-47F as Single Hotkey module
- Adds New Chatter theme Andersen
- Adds variable playback interval min/max for Andersen, Afghan and Fallon themes to better reflect activity levels
- Adds MH-6J as supported Community Module
- Fixes bug with rotary select SINGL on modules not using the new single PTT support
- Adds SRS PTT mapping version of Sleighzy's Single PTT support to AH-64D retaining TX5 as dedicated interphone PTT
- Adds AH-6J Little Bird mod as supported module commit by Sleighzy
- Adds full radio single PTT support for AH-64D WIP for other module implementation commit by Sleighzy
- Fix bug with Jester enable/disable Grid Nav
- Fix bug with F10 dynamic import not running after miz load
- Adds WIP campaign Key Phrases for Pacific Sentry 25
- Remove Kola Radio.lua update routine
- fix f10 menu items not being removed on reset
- fix blank space F10 Action Items
